mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT region FROM Stadium WHERE region IS NOT NULL ORDER BY region

SELECT s.stadium_id, s.stadium_name, s.region, s.capacity, s.status, s.latitude, s.longitude, s.addr1, s.addr2, s.zip, s.stadium_cost, s.stadium_img FROM Stadium s WHERE s.region = #{region} AND s.status = 1
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM Stadium_Issue si WHERE si.stadium_id = s.stadium_id AND TO_DATE(#{applyDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') BETWEEN TRUNC(si.start_date) AND TRUNC(si.end_date) )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM Match_Apply ma WHERE ma.stadium_id = s.stadium_id AND TRUNC(ma.apply_date) = TO_DATE( #{applyDate},'YYYY-MM-DD' ) AND ma.apply_time = #{applyTime} AND ma.status IN (1, 3) ) ORDER BY s.stadium_name

SELECT cmb_seq.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO clubMatchBoard (cmb_num, cmb_Subject, cmb_Content, cmb_HitCount, cmb_Reg_date, clubOwner_key) VALUES (#{cmb_num}, #{cmb_Subject}, #{cmb_Content}, 0, SYSDATE, #{clubOwner_key})

INSERT INTO Match_Apply ( apply_id, apply_date, apply_time, status, cancel_reason, stadium_id, clubOwner_key, match_type1, match_type2, clubOwner_key2, stadium_fee, cmb_num) VALUES (apply_id_seq.NEXTVAL, #{apply_date}, #{apply_time}, 3, NULL, #{stadium_id}, #{clubOwner_key}, #{match_type1}, #{match_type2}, NULL, #{stadium_fee, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{cmb_num})
mapper.select:
SELECT cmb_num, cmb_Subject, cmb_Content, cmb_HitCount, cmb_Reg_date, clubOwner_key, apply_id, apply_date, apply_time, match_status, stadium_id, stadium_name, region, addr1, addr2, zip, latitude, longitude, capacity, stadium_cost, home_clubOwner_key, match_type1, match_type2, away_clubOwner_key, applicantCount, targetCount FROM ( SELECT b.cmb_num, b.cmb_Subject, b.cmb_Content, b.cmb_HitCount, b.cmb_Reg_date, b.clubOwner_key, a.apply_id, a.apply_date, a.apply_time, a.status AS match_status, a.stadium_id, s.stadium_name, s.region, s.addr1, s.addr2, s.zip, s.latitude, s.longitude, s.capacity, s.stadium_cost, a.clubOwner_key AS home_clubOwner_key, a.match_type1, a.match_type2, a.clubOwner_key2 AS away_clubOwner_key,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clubMatchRequest r WHERE r.cmb_num = b.cmb_num AND r.request_state IN (1, 2) ) AS applicantCount,
CASE WHEN a.match_type1 = '11' THEN 11 WHEN a.match_type1 = '6' THEN 6 ELSE 0 END AS targetCount,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY b.cmb_num ORDER BY CASE WHEN a.status = 1 THEN 1 WHEN a.status = 2 THEN 2 WHEN a.status = 3 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, a.apply_id DESC ) AS rn FROM clubMatchBoard b INNER JOIN Match_Apply a ON b.cmb_num = a.cmb_num INNER JOIN Stadium s ON a.stadium_id = s.stadium_id WHERE a.status IN (1, 2, 3) AND b.clubOwner_key = #{clubOwnerKey} ) WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY cmb_Reg_date DESC FETCH FIRST 100 ROWS ONLY

SELECT b.cmb_num, b.cmb_Subject, b.cmb_Content, b.cmb_HitCount, b.cmb_Reg_date, b.clubOwner_key,
a.apply_id, a.apply_date, a.apply_time, a.status AS match_status, a.cancel_reason, a.stadium_id,
s.stadium_name, s.region, s.addr1, s.addr2, s.zip, s.stadium_img, s.latitude, s.longitude, s.capacity, s.stadium_cost,
a.clubOwner_key AS home_clubOwner_key, a.match_type1, a.match_type2, a.clubOwner_key2 AS away_clubOwner_key,
home.club_name AS home_clubName, away.club_name AS away_clubName
FROM clubMatchBoard b
INNER JOIN Match_Apply a ON b.cmb_num = a.cmb_num INNER JOIN Stadium s ON a.stadium_id = s.stadium_id INNER JOIN Club home ON a.clubOwner_key = home.clubOwner_key LEFT JOIN Club away ON a.clubOwner_key2 = away.clubOwner_key
WHERE b.cmb_num = #{cmb_num} AND a.status IN (1, 2, 3) ORDER BY CASE WHEN a.status = 1 THEN 1 WHEN a.status = 2 THEN 2 WHEN a.status = 3 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, a.apply_id DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT r.cmb_num, r.clubJoin_num, r.request_date, r.request_state, r.request_intro, r.reject_reason, r.request_cancel,
m.userName AS playerName
FROM clubMatchRequest r
INNER JOIN clubJoin cj ON r.clubJoin_num = cj.clubJoin_num INNER JOIN member1 m ON cj.memberIdx = m.memberIdx
WHERE r.cmb_num = #{cmb_num} ORDER BY r.request_date ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clubMatchRequest WHERE cmb_num = #{cmb_num} AND request_state IN (1, 2)
SELECT clubOwner_key FROM clubOwner WHERE memberIdx = #{memberIdx}
SELECT clubJoin_num FROM clubJoin WHERE memberIdx = #{memberIdx}
SELECT clubOwner_key FROM clubMatchBoard WHERE cmb_num = #{cmb_num}

mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT cmr.cmb_num, cmr.clubJoin_num, cmr.request_date, cmr.request_state, cmr.request_intro, cmr.request_cancel, cmb.cmb_subject, cmb.cmb_content, cmb.cmb_hitCount, cmb.cmb_reg_date, cmb.clubOwner_key,
ma.apply_id, ma.apply_date, ma.apply_time, ma.status, ma.cancel_reason, ma.stadium_id,
ma.clubOwner_key AS home_clubOwner_key, ma.match_type1, ma.match_type2, ma.clubOwner_key2 AS away_clubOwner_key,
s.stadium_name, s.region, s.addr1, s.addr2, s.latitude, s.longitude,
c1.club_name AS home_clubName, c2.club_name AS away_clubName,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY cmr.cmb_num ORDER BY CASE WHEN ma.clubOwner_key2 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, ma.apply_id DESC ) AS rn
FROM clubMatchRequest cmr
INNER JOIN clubMatchBoard cmb ON cmr.cmb_num = cmb.cmb_num INNER JOIN Match_Apply ma ON cmb.cmb_num = ma.cmb_num INNER JOIN Stadium s ON ma.stadium_id = s.stadium_id INNER JOIN Club c1 ON ma.clubOwner_key = c1.clubOwner_key LEFT JOIN Club c2 ON ma.clubOwner_key2 = c2.clubOwner_key
WHERE cmr.clubJoin_num = #{clubJoin_num} )
WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY request_date DESC, cmb_num DESC FETCH FIRST 100 ROWS ONLY
